$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0. Semantics: specs/conformance/observations.md, and specs/conformance/sync-ops.md for the outputs of sync and converge.
title: Observations of one scenario run
description: One output per scenario step, in step order (O1). Draft kinds accept any value until their area defines it.

search_text_outputs.description: specs/conformance/search-ops.md S6: {text} or a parse error (never a run error), one per case.

import_log_list.description: package-ops.md E6.3: I13's entries; note a target note's logical id or a real id.

render_av_entry.description: render-ops.md Q5.2, specs/render/av-tags.md A6: a sound entry by its decoded name, or a TTS entry by its language.

answer_label.description: observations.md O10, specs/sched/answer-labels.md: a label's prefix, amount and unit; the end label has amount "" and unit end, never less_than.

adopt.description: specs/conformance/normalized-dump.md N5: how many notes and cards got a logical id.

check_db.description: specs/conformance/collection-check.md K10: the K5 problem counts, or the rejection corrupt or failed.

check_media.description: specs/conformance/media-ops.md F14.1: the part of Check Media's report that Anki also gives.

delete_unused_media.description: specs/conformance/media-ops.md F14.2: the number of files trashed.

tag_missing_media.description: specs/conformance/media-ops.md F14.3: the number of notes written.

add_media.description: specs/conformance/media-ops.md F5: the stored name, or a Meguri-only rejection.

media_dir.description: media-ops.md F9: the media folder's entries by name: files as {sha1, size}, subdirectories as {dir: true}.

media_trash.description: media-ops.md F10: trash entries sorted by name (UTF-8 bytes), then sha1.

media_pending.description: media-ops.md F11: entries pending for the next media sync; null for a deletion.

media_quick_check.description: media-sync-ops.md V1: after the change check a media sync begins with, entries pending for the next media sync; null for a deletion.

media_sync.description: media-sync-ops.md V3: what one media sync did, or a rejection of the op's closed list.

db_exec.description: specs/conformance/record-ops.md W1: the rows the statement returned; [] when none.

open.description: specs/conformance/storage-ops.md P1.2: a successful open records {}, so this member holds only a rejection.

schema_objects.description: storage-ops.md P3: sqlite_master rows sorted by type, then name; sql normalized.

schema11_copy.description: storage-ops.md P4: a successful copy records {}, so this member holds only a rejection.

file_col.description: storage-ops.md P5: the requested col columns of a session file; integers as stored, the JSON columns parsed.

file_objects.description: storage-ops.md P6: schema_objects of a session file.

file_query.description: storage-ops.md P7: the rows the statement returned on a session file; [] when none.

answer_labels.description: observations.md O10: the four answer button labels of each card, as parts.

ignored_before_count.description: deck-options-ops.md E2: one entry per date text, the counts or invalid_date.

legacy_json.description: model-ops.md L1: schema-11 objects keyed by record name.

legacy_update.description: model-ops.md L2: the op has no output, so only a rejection appears.

ensure_io_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T6: the Image Occlusion note type's stored name.

change_notetype_info.description: change-notetype-ops.md H1: names, default maps, their loss preview, counts and the schema stamp, or a rejection.

change_notetype.description: change-notetype-ops.md H2: the number of notes changed, or a rejection (multiple_notetypes is Meguri's only).

empty_cards.description: empty-cards-ops.md Y1: per note type with empty cards, in the scan's order, its notes (ascending id) with the ordinals of their empty cards.

delete_empty_cards.description: empty-cards-ops.md Y2: cards deleted and listed cards kept because they became valid (always 0 on the oracle, notes/empty-cards E5).

notetype_structure.description: notetype-ops.md T8: note types by stored name, without template text, CSS or ids.

restore_notetype.description: notetype-structure-ops.md M2: the op has no output, so only a rejection appears.

notetype_templates.description: notetype-structure-ops.md M3: per stored name, the templates in ordinal order with their four texts as stored.

blob_decode.description: model-ops.md L4: per record, ok or invalid_blob.

export.description: dsl.md D7.2: the legacy package form and the deck package form output {notes} (model-ops.md L6, package-ops.md E7), the deck package form or its rejection; the collection package form outputs nothing (package-ops.md E1); the other forms are draft (package).

import.description: package-ops.md E2.3, E6.3, E6.4: the collection package forms output nothing, so this member holds only their rejection; the deck package form outputs the import log or its rejection.

package_media.description: package-ops.md E10: the package's media map records in map order (latest) or ascending member number (legacy), sha1 lower-case hex, entry_size the numbered entry's decoded size.

package_db_dump.description: package-ops.md E11: db_dump's value (O8) of the package's collection entry.

package_listing.description: package-ops.md E3: the archive's entries in order with their compression methods, the meta version (null without a meta entry, invalid when it does not decode), and the facts of each raw SQLite entry.

package_col.description: model-ops.md L7: the requested col columns of a legacy package's collection; ver an integer, the JSON columns parsed.

cloze.description: specs/conformance/cloze-ops.md Z1: one array per requested function, one output per input in input order.

fsrs_next.description: float-determinism.md F3.3, F5.2: one row per input, in input order: days, stability and difficulty for again, hard, good and easy.

type_answer.description: specs/conformance/type-answer-ops.md K1: one array per requested function, one comparison per input in input order.

review_html.description: specs/conformance/type-answer-ops.md K2: ordered HTML results or a typed replacement refusal.

text.description: O4 text: one array per requested function, one output per input in input order.

render_status.description: specs/conformance/render-ops.md Q4.3: per card, its stored ordinal and whether it renders for review from its stored templates; null when the card no longer exists.

template.description: specs/conformance/render-ops.md Q1.5: one result per case, in case order.

render.description: specs/conformance/render-ops.md Q5.2: per card, the card render pipeline's outputs in review and browser mode; null for a card that no longer exists.

image_occlusion.description: specs/conformance/image-occlusion-ops.md J2: one array per requested function, one output per input in input order.

fields_check.description: specs/conformance/note-ops.md N4: one result per case, in case order; duplicates only with the state duplicate.

studied_today_raw.description: stats-ops.md H2: the counted rows and the sum of their stored time.

studied_today_text.description: stats-ops.md H5: the Home studied-today line (stats/studied-today T2), English.

studied_today_format.description: stats-ops.md H6: the Home line for each requested pair, in request order.

today_stats.description: stats-ops.md H7: the Stats Today values (stats/studied-today T3.3) per requested scope, in request order.

stats.description: stats-ops.md H10, stats/graphs-common G14: per request, in order, the requested parts of Anki's graph data in protobuf field names (map keys decimal strings, scalars at 0 and empty maps omitted), or a search error, or unreadable_row.

card_stats.description: stats-ops.md H9, stats/card-info C3 and C6.1: the backend's card stats per requested card; every member present, null for an unset optional.

browser_config.description: specs/conformance/browser-config-ops.md B2: the 23 browser and search config keys as Anki's own reads give them; the last eight are stored JSON values of any shape.

force_backup.description: specs/conformance/backup-ops.md F3: the file name of the new backup.

backup_files.description: backup-ops.md F5: the regular files of the backups folder, sorted by their UTF-8 bytes.

backup_settings.description: backup-ops.md F6: the backup limits as read now, defaults included.

backup.description: specs/conformance/backup-trigger-ops.md H1: the file name of the backup the step made, or null when it made none.

rename_tag.description: tag-ops.md G4: notes written, or the rejection invalid_name.

set_flag.description: tag-ops.md G8: cards written, or the rejection invalid_flag.

tag_tree.description: tag-ops.md G9: top-level nodes of the tag tree (specs/tags/tags.md T13).

tag_complete.description: specs/tags/complete.md C7: one list of registered tag names per case, in the order returned.

add_defaults.description: specs/notes/add-defaults.md D7: the starting deck and note type by stored name (the deck in human form), or D1's error kind.

notetype_last_deck.description: specs/notes/add-defaults.md D7: the note type's default deck (D2) by stored name in human form, or null for none.

set_due.description: specs/conformance/sched-ops.md J6: the op has no output, so only the rejection invalid_days appears.

empty_filtered.description: sched-ops.md J9: the op has no output, so only the rejection not_filtered appears.

save_deck_options.description: deck-options-ops.md E1: the op has no output, so only a rejection appears: default_preset when remove names the default preset.

undo.description: undo-ops.md V1: the op has no output, so only a rejection appears; changed_externally is Meguri's only.

redo.description: undo-ops.md V1: the op has no output, so only a rejection appears; changed_externally is Meguri's only.

undo_status.description: undo-ops.md V2: the step an undo and a redo would apply now, or null.

card_excerpts.description: specs/conformance/card-excerpt-ops.md E2: one entry per requested reference, in request order: the Question and Deck cells of a found card, or missing or damaged.

search.description: specs/conformance/search-ops.md S1: one output per request, in request order; with order, specs/conformance/browser-ops.md B1, B2.

ids.description: Without order: #cN (cards mode) or #nN (notes mode) in logical-id order, then real ids of unnamed rows in ascending order. With order: the sorted result, unnamed rows as real ids at their place, each equal-key run in logical-id order (browser-ops.md B2).

anyOf.description: browser-ops.md B1: the order names a column that is not one of the 19 keys or not sortable in the request's mode.

browser_rows.description: specs/conformance/browser-ops.md B3, B4: one entry per requested reference, in request order.

card_extractors.description: extractor-ops.md E3: one row per input, in input order: the memory-state fields s, d, dr, retrievability r, relative retrievability rr and original position pos; REAL results as f32 (O6), infinities as "inf" and "-inf", NULL as null.

search_build.description: specs/conformance/search-ops.md S6: one output per built item, in order.

search_join.description: specs/conformance/search-ops.md S6: one output per join case, in order.

search_replace.description: specs/conformance/search-ops.md S6: one output per replace case, in order.

canonical_search.description: specs/conformance/search-ops.md S2: one output per query text, in order; parse errors only.

sync.description: specs/conformance/sync-ops.md S4: a result, or a rejection of the op's closed list.

add_deck.description: specs/conformance/deck-ops.md K2: the stored human name of the deck returned, or a rejection.

rename_deck.description: deck-ops.md K3: the deck's stored human name after the op, or a rejection (under_descendant is Meguri's only).

reparent_decks.description: deck-ops.md K4: the number of listed decks that moved, or a rejection.

delete_decks.description: deck-ops.md K5: the number of cards removed.

remove_preset.description: deck-ops.md K9: the op has no output, so only a rejection appears.

set_deck_preset.description: deck-ops.md K10: the op has no output, so only a rejection appears.

decks.description: deck-ops.md K11: every deck, keyed by its stored name in human form.

deck_tree.description: deck-ops.md K12: the top-level nodes of the deck tree in order (decks/decks.md D12).

queue.description: specs/conformance/queue-ops.md Q2: the current deck's study queue in presentation order, each card's kind, and the queue's counts.

deck_counts.description: queue-ops.md Q3: the deck list's top-level nodes in order, with the counts it shows.

congrats.description: queue-ops.md Q4: a finished deck's facts for the current deck (specs/sched/counts.md C7).

differences.description: Per actor, the pointers into the dump where the actor's raw dump differs from the fresh client's; [] when it converged.

schema_object_list.description: storage-ops.md P3: one entry per sqlite_master row, sorted by type, then name; sql normalized (P3.2), null when SQLite stores none.

browser_cell.description: specs/conformance/browser-ops.md B4; unparsed is the oracle's record of a text it could not read, which no Meguri cell equals.

undo_step.description: undo-ops.md V4: the id of an undo step's name.

search_error.description: specs/search/errors.md E1 kinds; provided and context per E2, backticks replaced by apostrophes (search-ops.md S3).

objects_by_id.description: schema11-json S12: decimal id -> schema-11 object.

db_dump.description: observations.md O8: table -> primary key text -> column -> value.

dump_value.description: By SQLite storage class: INTEGER integer, REAL number, TEXT string, NULL null, BLOB {sha256}.

notetype_save.description: notetype-ops.md T2-T5: the stored name, or a rejection of T7.

rejection.description: An op Anki refused (dsl.md D7.3). An op whose D7.2 row lists rejection kinds takes anyOf [its output, this with error restricted to those kinds]; the others record none.

graph_int_map.description: stats/graphs-common G14: a protobuf map with integer keys as decimal strings; omitted when empty.

check_db_counts.description: collection-check.md K5: every kind present, 0 when Anki reported none of it; notetypes_recovered is 1 when reported (its message has no number).

extractor_real.description: extractor-ops.md E3: a REAL result as its f32 (O6), an infinity as a string, NULL as null.

sql_value.description: record-ops.md W1, by SQLite storage class: INTEGER integer, REAL number, TEXT string, NULL null, BLOB {sha256}.
